data.long_meaning: The name Dorthy is derived from the Old English word thorith, meaning 'door' or 'gift.' The name was later adopted from the Old Greek Dorothea, which translates to 'gift of God.' Dorthy is a name rich in symbolism, representing the idea of God's blessings and protection. The name Dorthy carries the meaning “Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Dorthy usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name carries a cheerful and wholesome connotation, reminiscent of the simple yet strong-willed character Dorothy from Oz.
